methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Since energy management comprises many different elements, a methodology is needed to decide whether a company really practices energy management. Based on the research of Christoffersen (2006), a list of minimum requirements with which to split the studied companies into two categories was developed [26]: those companies with energy management practices and those without.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Questionnaire-based energy-management practice assessment; no EnPI or EnB measurement model is identified or characterised.

paper_type.evidence_quote: Thus, a comprehensive set of minimum requirements was developed, with which the rate of energy management application in energy intensive industries in Turkey was determined in this study.

stage1.notes: The paper evaluates organisational energy-management practices across 40 companies using a minimum-requirements framework, not an EnPI/EnB model.
